controllerType: K6 Electronic Control (ASD58, LCD operation panel with stepper motors)
type: Coverseam / flatseam sewing machine electronic control box with stepper motor thread trimming and presser foot

specs.display: LCD operation panel with icons for sewing mode, parameters, presser foot, needle position, trimming, and step motor indicators
specs.factoryResetMethod: Long press the reset button on the panel for 3 seconds to restore the factory-saved parameters (one-key recovery)
specs.oneKeySave: Press P + presser foot combination key; item 024 appears; then long press right key to save parameters
specs.softwareVersion: Press P + scissors key to view software version. Press plus key to switch between electronic control and panel software versions.
specs.stepperMotors: Up to 2 stepper motors: for thread trimming/presser foot lifting and for adjusting stitch length. Configured via parameter 11F.

errorCodes.cause: Hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the power to the system and turn it back on after 30 seconds. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Power down
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the power to the system and turn it back on after 30 seconds. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: System undervoltage — input power supply voltage is low (less than 176V)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power and check whether the input power voltage is low (less than 176V). If the power supply voltage is low, please restart the controller after the voltage returns to normal. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Overvoltage during shutdown — input voltage too high (above 264V)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power and check whether the input power voltage is too high (above 264V). If the power supply voltage is too high, please restart the controller after the voltage returns to normal. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Overvoltage during operation — supply voltage exceeds threshold while sewing
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power and check whether the input power voltage is too high (above 264V). Restart after voltage returns to normal. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Electromagnet circuit failure — solenoid connection is loose or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the power of the system and check whether the solenoid connection is correct, whether it is loose or damaged. If so, replace it in time. Restart the system after confirming that it is correct. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Current detection circuit failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power and reconnect power after 30 seconds. If the fault still occurs frequently after retrying several times, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stalled — motor power input plug is off, loose, or broken; or foreign matter tangled on machine head
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the motor power input plug is off, loose, or broken, and whether there is any foreign matter entangled on the machine head. After troubleshooting, restarting the system still does not work normally, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit failure — white brake resistor connector on power supply board is loose or has fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the white brake resistor connector on the power supply board is loose or has fallen off. Plug it in tightly and restart the system. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: HMI communication failure — connection between control panel and controller is disconnected, loose, or broken
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the connection between the control panel and controller is off, loose, or broken. Restore it to normal and restart the system. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Head stop needle signal failure — connection between head synchronization signal device and controller is loose
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the connection between the head synchronization signal device and controller is loose. Restore it to normal and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor initial angle detection failure
errorCodes.solution: Please try 2-3 times after power off. If the fault is still reported, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor HALL failure — motor sensor connector is off, loose, or damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power. Check whether the motor sensor connector is off, loose, or damaged. Restore it to normal and restart the system. If it still does not work, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: DSP read and write EEPROM failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still does not work, replace the controller. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overspeed protection
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still does not work, replace the controller. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor reverse — motor is running in the wrong direction
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still does not work, replace the controller. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: HMI reading and writing EEPROM failure
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still does not work, replace the controller. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overload
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still does not work, replace the controller. Contact local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Broken wire detection — thread break detection triggered
errorCodes.solution: Change the P18 parameter to 0 to disable broken wire detection if it is triggering falsely.

errorCodes.cause: Stepper motor failure — stepper motor stopped, zero position will alarm
errorCodes.solution: When the stepper motor is stopped, the zero position will alarm and the electronic control can be restarted. If it still does not work normally, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Stepper motor failure — stepper motor stopped at incorrect zero position
errorCodes.solution: When the stepper motor is stopped, the zero position will alarm and the electronic control can be restarted. If it still does not work normally, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Stepper board failure
errorCodes.solution: When the stepper motor is stopped, the zero position will alarm and the electronic control can be restarted. If it still does not work normally, please replace the controller. If the above still cannot be resolved, please contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

alarmCodes.cause: Refueling time reminder — lubrication maintenance interval reached
alarmCodes.solution: 247 parameters control the switch and time. Perform machine lubrication then reset the alarm.

alarmCodes.cause: Needle counting alarm — number of stitches has reached the upper limit set
alarmCodes.solution: Press the P key to cancel the alarm and restart the count.

alarmCodes.cause: Count number of thread trimming alarm — trimming count has reached the set upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press the P key to cancel the alarm and restart the count.

alarmCodes.cause: Needle lift lock status — alarm triggered after selecting stepper motor mode
alarmCodes.solution: After selecting the stepper motor it will give an alarm. Press the P key to clear.

alarmCodes.cause: Safety switch alarm — trimming cutter is not back in original place, or safety switch light does not turn on after cutter returns
alarmCodes.solution: Check whether the thread trimmer is back in place. If the safety switch light does not turn on after it is back in place, adjust the position of the induction bracket. If it still does not solve the problem, change the 2 in the P66 parameter to 0. If the above still fails, contact your local service provider or call 4008876858.

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-27/Err-28/Err-31 stepper motor or stepper board failure on K6
checks: Turn off power and restart — stepper motor zero position alarm can often be cleared with a restart
Check all stepper motor cable connections
Inspect stepper motor for mechanical obstruction preventing it from reaching zero position
Check stepper board connections at both controller and stepper motor ends
If restart doesn't resolve it, replace the controller
Contact service provider or call 4008876858 if issue persists

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-22 broken wire detection alarm on K6
checks: If triggered falsely (no actual thread break): set P18 parameter to 0 to disable broken wire detection
If thread is genuinely breaking: check needle condition, thread path, thread tension, and bobbin
Check the thread breakage sensor wiring if P18 > 0 and detection is needed

troubleshooting.symptom: UP safety switch alarm on K6 — machine won't run
checks: Check that the thread trimmer scissors have returned fully to the home position after trimming
Verify the safety switch indicator light turns on when the cutter is in home position
If light doesn't turn on: adjust position of the induction bracket for the safety switch sensor
If still not resolved after adjusting bracket: change P66 parameter from 2 to 0 to disable safety switch
Contact service provider or call 4008876858 if above steps fail

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-03 undervoltage on K6 coverseam machine
checks: Turn off the system power
Check input power supply voltage with a multimeter — must be at least 176V (220V -20%)
Do not restart until voltage is stable and within 176V-264V range
Once voltage is normal, restart the controller
If error persists with correct voltage, contact service provider or call 4008876858
Turn off system power
Check motor power input plug — must be firmly seated, not loose, off, or broken
Check for foreign matter (thread, fabric) tangled around the motor shaft or machine head
Clear any obstruction, re-seat plugs, then restart
If motor still stalls, replace the controller

troubleshooting.symptom: Stepper motor not trimming or not lifting presser foot correctly on K6
checks: Check parameter 11F — must match the actual stepper motor configuration (1 = one stepper for trimming/lifting; 3 = two steppers)
Check P85 (stepper motor lifting angle) and P86 (trimming angle) — values may need tuning
Check P88 — direction setting must match actual installation
Inspect stepper motor cable connections
Use monitoring item 01C (trimming stepper steps) and 01D (needle pitch stepper steps) to verify operation
Perform lubrication maintenance on the machine as specified in the mechanical manual
After lubricating, reset the refueling alarm counter via the parameter that controls refueling interval
